preconditions.description: Input s must be a non-empty string.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789 ' for c in s)
preconditions.description: Input s contains only English letters (case-insensitive), digits, and spaces.
Input s contains at least one non-space character (i.e., at least one word).

postconditions.expression: all(word in s.split() for word in stdout.split()) and all(word in stdout.split() for word in s.split())
postconditions.description: The output string contains exactly the same words as the input string, ignoring extra spaces.
The words in the output string are in reverse order of their appearance in the input string.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == stdout and '  ' not in stdout
postconditions.description: The output string has no leading or trailing spaces and no multiple spaces between words.
